g.text: All 32 Business Universals · columns are concrete role steps · Project is the universal work context · C=create, R=read/reference, W=write/transition
C create · R read/reference · W write/transition · combined modes are shown as C/W, R/W, etc.
Empty cell = this step does not require that Universal. The matrix is a design test, not a requirement to use every Universal in every timeline.
